objective.primaryRule: per (cutoff, arm), on the arm's own qualified population (its four lanes' shortlists qualified under the arm's Q1-Q6): P0 = NL0 1.0.0's original rule, the actual-profit role (highest centre net; ties selection robust, lower centre DD, label) - the reference; RA1-original = Assignment 2's RA1 unchanged (S1 open-lot multiple <= 1.50, S2 open-lot share <= 25%, S3 worst lot MAE >= -$17,500, S4 selection worst-10% mean DD <= 35% of C0; fewest failed screens, then the lowest occupancy within 5% of the best conservative training net, then ties) in both arms; RA1-adapted (EXP only) = RA1 with only S4 = 40% of C0. Comparison selectors on identical populations; no selector launches an evaluation.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (C0, not peak account equity); the CTRL arm keeps the $35,000 rule exactly; the EXP arm's envelope (marked DD <= 40% of C0, trade principal loss <= 25% of the funded entry principal, banked-capital DD <= 25% of C0, liquidation basis) is departure RD1

budget.notes: Distinct candidate proposals (centres; refinement moves apart): 16 lanes x (512 screen + 2-6 islands x 256) = 16,384 configured base / 32,768 maximum (8,192 / 16,384 per arm). Backend evaluations: the authorized ceiling of 700,000 REQUESTED pilot research evaluations (search + qualification + next intervals; archive hits included); the deterministic bound from the frozen schedules is 693,652 (16 lanes x the per-lane cap 41,000 + 2 cutoffs x <= 26 members x 653 + 2 x <= 7 subjects x 264). Expected about 0.27-0.38 M. Counted separately per arm, lane, rung tag, cutoff and stage: requested, fresh, archive hits; engineering verification (E2 reads records; E3 non-official mini-pilot on D19 and edge subjects) and the nonbinding CPU diagnostics are not pilot research evaluations.

evaluationBackend.notes: Every official evaluation (search, qualification, next intervals) runs only through openOfficialGpuSession -> GpuPool -> EvalLab on the accepted Phase 7 evaluator (record sha256 bb0e3fcf6bde45cc..., binary gb7 cb2ff30b..., RTX 5090 GPU-ae5f222c...), with the risk envelope requested on every evaluation; no CPU fallback, auto backend or hybrid. CPU runs only under non-official purposes: parity-test (engineering gate E3) and diagnostic (the nonbinding D1-D3, DD^L, interval-window and scaling diagnostics of frozen selections).

chronologicalConsequence: Standard 3.0.0 §1.8 default, adopted: the pilot runs two cutoffs with one next interval each and no sequential fold path (departure RD2), so every pilot selection is labelled 'no chronological support: not a deployment-qualified candidate without an explicit user decision'. The next intervals (C21 -> 2022-2023, C24 -> 2025-2026) are retrospective, previously inspected history, never a pristine holdout. 'No qualifying candidate' in an arm is a valid outcome. Governance only: never a fitness term, ranking input or gate.

deviations.description: The EXP arm replaces the $35,000 marked-DD ceiling by the envelope (marked DD <= 40% of C0, trade principal loss <= 25% of funded principal, banked-capital DD <= 25% of C0, liquidation basis) in every stage of its search, qualification and selection; the CTRL arm keeps the standard's rule exactly. The standard is not changed.
